extraction: Agent capsules fifth axis: capsules have 5 dimensions — (1) Capability, (2) Interface, (3) State, (4) Policy, (5) Identity. Fifth axis = Identity (who am I, what are my bounds). Maps to our 3 agents: Engine identity = 'builder, no verify, no patch'. Verdict identity = 'verifier, no build, no patch'. Miss identity = 'applier, no build, no verify'. Identity enforces role boundaries. Capsules with identity don't cross lanes. Our agents = lightweight capsules with identity.
